decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. Increase only the already-qualified far/moderate current-visible compound target ceiling from36 to38. Preserve all lateral behavior and target30 for near obstacles, extreme curvature, strong steering and detector misses. Do not claim lap-time, clearance, completion, submission or SOTA improvement until an authorized paired driving evaluation passes the finish-and-safety-first gate.

feedback_assessment.accepted: Obstacle-local slowdown is supported: the latest videos show a0.88 median post/pre speed proxy and13 of26 encounters lose at least10 percent; the prior selective brake change coincided with lower times on all three source-unbound videos.
rejected_or_unproven: Obstacle count does not explain the three current lap-time differences because every official track has six obstacles and time correlates0.991 with recovered track length.

Intentional grass or off-road use is not adopted: simulator termination is not immediate for every brief excursion, but competition legality is unverified, grass friction is0.6 and sustained off-track behavior can retire the car.
More aggressive obstacle steering is not adopted because it can reduce clearance or trigger the existing strong-steer target30 veto.

official_sources.site_status: The competition website hostname was unavailable, so no claim relies on it.
